title: Dierdre
summary: Dierdre is a Gaia-Titan who takes on the appearance of a green-toned maiden. embellished in glowing roots and vines.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
In Irish legend, Dierdre is the known as the foremost tragic heroine, foretold by the Druids to be a beautiful but lonely young woman. {{source|:wikipedia:Dierdre|Wikipedia}}

A Dierdre Titan is used on the side of good. {{Source|TCG: LGS-032| LGS-032}}
